application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
NOTH BLOCK FRONT
AREA AF
AF5-Lilac(Syringa)-shrub
-light reduction to shape and tidy

AF4-Cotoneaster(C.fridigus)
-reduce crown by 25%(1.3m) to suitable growth points
-thin by 15% to shape and tidy lateral branch spread
RETAINED HT-2m
RETAINED SPREAD-3m

AF6-Elderberry(Sambucus nigra)
-reduce all long stems by up to 1.75m to suitable growth both
RETAINED HT-1.75m
RETAINED SPREAD-1.5m

AREA BF
BF3-Fig(Ficus carica)
-reduce crown by 30%(2m) ro suitable growth points
-reduce lateral spread on both pavement side and with emphasis on inbound side of grass area
-remove any crossing/suppressed branches
RETAINED HT-2.75m
RETAINED SPREAD-4.5m

BF4-Norway Maple(Acer platanoides)-possibly diseased with dead N-facing section, bark shrinkage observed(drought damage)
-reduce crown by 25% removing new growth back to previous points
-remove N-facing possibly dead section limbs back to main trunks
RETAINED HT-2.75m
RETAINED SPREAD-3.5m

AREA CF
CF1-Cherry(Prunus)
-light 25%(1m) crown reduction to shape and tidy
RETAINED HT-2m
RETAINED SPREAD-3m

CF2-Elderberry(Sambucus nigra)
-reduce all long stems by up to 1.75m to suitable growth points
RETAINED HT-1.75m
RETAINED SPREAD-1.5m

CF3-Sycamore(Acer pseudoplatanus)
-light 25% crown reduction shortening long vertical leaders by 1.5m
-prune lateral spread with emphasis  outbound over pavement and inbound over grass area
RETAINED HT-2.75m
RETAINED SPREAD-1.8m

AREA DF
DF1-Cherry Plum(Prunus cerasifera)
-reduce  crown by 25%(1.2m) to suitable growth points
-thin by removing all fine branch epicormic growth to main stems
RETAINED HT-1.5m
RETAINED SPREAD-1.8m

DF2-Cherry Laurel(Prunus laurosiferus)
-reduce height by up to 1m to suitable growth points
-trim side growth to shape and tidy
RETAINED HT-2.25m
RETAINED SPREAD-2.75m

NORTH BLOCK REAR
CB2-Mahonia
-remove 1x crossing stem

CB3-Magnolia(M.soulangea)
-reduce crown by 25%(1.75m) to suitable growth points
-reduce lateral branch spread to match(1.2m) ensuring 1.2m separation for neighbouring property
-thin where necessary and shape to balance and tidy
RETAINED HT-3.25m
RETAINED SPREAD-3m

CB4-Hazel(Corylus alvana)
-reduce crown by 25%(1m) to suitable growth points
-thin by remove selected outer stems to ground level
RETAINED HT-1.8m
RETAINED SPREAD-1m

AREA AB
In east corner by new fencing section 
AB1 - Hazel(Corylus alvana)
-hard coppice to retain 0.75m above ground level
RETAINED HT-0.75m
RETAINED SPREAD-1m

SOUTH BLOCK REAR
AREA EB
EB2-Silver Birch(Betula pendula)
-reduce crown by 25%(2m) to suitable growth points
-reduce lateral spread to match(2m) to shape, balance and tidy
RETAINED HT-4m
RETAINED SPREAD-3.75m

All works are for routine maintenance.
